G4905.strongs: to convene, depart in company with, associate with, or (specially), cohabit (conjugally)
G4905.kjv: accompany, assemble (with), come (together), come (company, go) with, resort
senses: συν-έρχομαι

(cl.) to come together, assemble: [[r:MRK.3.20|Mrk 3:20 14:53]], T, WH, txt., [[r:ACT.1.6|Act 1:6 2:6 10:27 16:13 19:32 21:22 22:30 28:17]], [[r:1CO.14.26|1Co 14:26]]; before εἰς, with accusative loc., [[r:ACT.5.16|Act 5:16]]; ἐπὶ τ. αὐτό, [[r:1CO.11.20|1Co 11:20 14:23]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:MRK.14.53|Mrk 14:53]], WH, mg., R (πρὸς αὐτόν, see Field, Notes, 40), [[r:JHN.11.33|Jhn 11:33]]; ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ, [[r:1CO.11.18|1Co 11:18]]; ἐνθάδε, [[r:ACT.25.17|Act 25:17]]; [[r:MRK.6.33|Mrk 6:33]], WH, mg. (cf. WH, Intr., 95 ff.); ὅπου, [[r:JHN.18.20|Jhn 18:20]]; with inf., [[r:LUK.5.15|Luk 5:15]]; εἰς τ. φαγεῖν, [[r:1CO.11.33|1Co 11:33]]; εἰς τ. ἧσσον, [[r:1CO.11.17|1Co 11:17 11:34]]; of sexual intercourse (Xen., al.; γυναικί or absol.), [[r:MAT.1.18|Mat 1:18.]]

In later sense (see exx. in Milligan, Selections, 64, 105), to accompany: with dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.23.55|Luk 23:55]], [[r:ACT.1.21|Act 1:21 9:39 10:23, 45 11:12]]; before σύν, [[r:ACT.21.16|Act 21:16]]; εἰς, [[r:ACT.15.38|Act 15:38.]]† (AS)

G4982.root: from a primary σῶς (contraction for obsolete σάος, "safe")
G4982.strongs: to save, i.e. deliver or protect (literally or figuratively)
G4982.kjv: heal, preserve, save (self), do well, be (make) whole
senses: σώζω (on the more accurate σῴζω, see WH, Intr., §410; Bl., §3, 1-3), to save from peril, injury or suffering: [[r:MAT.8.25|Mat 8:25]], [[r:MRK.13.20|Mrk 13:20]], [[r:LUK.23.35|Luk 23:35]], al.; τ. ψυχήν, [[r:MAT.16.25|Mat 16:25]], al.; before ἐκ, [[r:JHN.12.27|Jhn 12:27]], [[r:HEB.5.7|Heb 5:7]], Ju 5; of healing, restoring to health: [[r:MAT.9.22|Mat 9:22]], [[r:MRK.5.34|Mrk 5:34]], al. In NT, esp. of salvation from spiritual disease and death, in which sense it is "spoken of in Scripture as either (1) past, (2) present, or (3) future, according as redemption, grace, or glory is the point in view. Thus (1) [[r:ROM.8.24|Rom 8:24]], [[r:EPH.2.5|Eph 2:5]], 8 [[r:2TI.1.9|2Ti 1:9]], [[r:TIT.3.5|Tit 3:5]]; (2) [[r:ACT.2.47|Act 2:47]], [[r:1COR.1.18|1Co 1:18]], 15:2, [[r:2CO.2.15|2Co 2:15]]; (3) [[r:MAT.10.22|Mat 10:22]], [[r:ROM.13.11|Rom 13:11]], [[r:PHP.2.12|Php 2:12]], [[r:HEB.9.28|Heb 9:28]]" (Vau. on [[r:ROM.5.9|Rom 5:9]]). Seq. ἀπό, [[r:MAT.1.21|Mat 1:21]], [[r:ACT.2.40|Act 2:40]], [[r:ROM.5.9|Rom 5:9]]; ἐκ, [[r:JAS.5.20|Jas 5:20]], Ju 23 (cf. Cremer, 532ff.). (AS)

G4970.strongs: of uncertain derivation) as adverb; vehemently, i.e. in a high degree, much
senses: σφόδρα adv. (prop. neut. of σφοδρός, excessive, violent) very, very much, exceedingly: with verbs, [[r:MAT.17.6|Mat 17:6, 23 18:31 19:25 26:22 27:54]], [[r:ACT.6.7|Act 6:7]]; with adjectives, [[r:MAT.2.10|Mat 2:10]], [[r:MRK.16.4|Mrk 16:4]], [[r:LUK.18.23|Luk 18:23]], [[r:REV.16.21|Rev 16:21]].† (AS)

G4947.strongs: Syria (i.e. Tsyria or Tyre), a region of Asia

G4912.strongs: to hold together, i.e. to compress (the ears, with a crowd or siege) or arrest (a prisoner); figuratively, to compel, perplex, afflict, preoccupy
G4912.kjv: constrain, hold, keep in, press, lie sick of, stop, be in a strait, straiten, be taken with, throng
senses: συν-έχω

to hold together (τ. συνέχον τ. πάντα, [[r:WIS.1.7|Wis 1:7]]): of closing the ears, [[r:ACT.7.57|Act 7:57]] (τ. στόμα, [[r:ISA.52.15|Isa 52:15]]); to hem in, press on every side: [[r:LUK.8.45|Luk 8:45 19:43]].
to hold fast;
of a prisoner, to hold in charge (Luc.; cf. exx. in Deiss., BS, 160; MM, xxiv): [[r:LUK.22.63|Luk 22:63]];

to constrain: [[r:2CO.5.14|2Co 5:14]]; pass., [[r:LUK.12.50|Luk 12:50]], [[r:ACT.18.5|Act 18:5]] (τ. λόγῳ; cf. Field, Notes, 128), [[r:PHP.1.23|Php 1:23]]; in pass., of ills, to be seized or afflicted by, suffering from: [[r:MAT.4.24|Mat 4:24]], [[r:LUK.4.38|Luk 4:38 8:37]], [[r:ACT.28.8|Act 28:8]].† (AS)

G4983.strongs: the body (as a sound whole), used in a very wide application, literally or figuratively
senses: a body.
Prop., of the human body,
as always in Hom. (opposite to δέμας), of the dead body: [[r:MAT.27.58|Mat 27:58, 59]] [[r:MRK.15.43|Mrk 15:43]], al.;

of the living body: [[r:LUK.11.34|Luk 11:34]], [[r:1CO.6.13|1Co 6:13]], al.; ἐν σ. εἶναι, [[r:HEB.13.3|Heb 13:3]]; as the instrument of the soul, τὰ διὰ τοῦ σ., [[r:2CO.5.10|2Co 5:10]]; opposite to πνεῦμα, [[r:ROM.8.10|Rom 8:10]], [[r:1CO.5.3|1Co 5:3 7:4]], [[r:JAS.2.26|Jas 2:26]]; to ψυχή, [[r:MAT.6.25|Mat 6:25 10:28]], [[r:LUK.12.22|Luk 12:22]] (cf. [[r:WIS.1.1|Wis 1:1]], al.); to τὸ π. καὶ ἡ ψ., [[r:1TH.5.23|1Th 5:23]]; σ. ψυχικόν, opposite to σ. πνευματικόν, [[r:1CO.15.44|1Co 15:44]]; ὁ ναὸς τοῦ σ. αὐτοῦ (genitive epexeg.), [[r:JHN.2.21|Jhn 2:21]]; τὸ σ. τ. ταπεινώσεως (Hebraistic "genitive of definition"; M, Pr., 73f.; Bl., §35, 5), opposite to τὸ σ. τ. δοξῆς αὐτοῦ, [[r:PHP.3.21|Php 3:21]]; similarly, τὸ σ. τ. σαρκός, [[r:COL.1.22|Col 1:22]]; σ. τοῦ θανάτου (subject to death), [[r:ROM.7.24|Rom 7:24]]; σ. τ. ἁμαρτίας, [[r:ROM.6.6|Rom 6:6]]; (with) periphr., ἀνθρώπου, then absol., σῶμα (Soph., Xen., al.), a person, and in later writers (Polyb., al.), a slave: [[r:REV.18.13|Rev 18:13]] (cf. MM, i, ii, xxiv; Deiss., BS, 160).
Of the bodies of animals: living, [[r:JAS.3.3|Jas 3:3]]; dead, [[r:HEB.13.11|Heb 13:11]] ( [[r:EXO.29.14|Exo 29:14]], al.).
Of inanimate objects (cf. Eng. "heavenly bodies"): [[r:1CO.15.37|1Co 15:37, 38 40]] (Diod., al.).

Of any corporeal substance (Plat., al.): opposite to σκιά, [[r:COL.2.17|Col 2:17.]] Metaphorical, of a number of persons united by a common bond; in NT, of the Church as the spiritual body of Christ: [[r:ROM.12.5|Rom 12:5]], [[r:1CO.10.16|1Co 10:16, 17 12:13, 27]], [[r:EPH.1.23|Eph 1:23 2:16 4:4, 12, 16 5:23, 30]], [[r:COL.1.18|Col 1:18, 24 2:19 3:15]]; ἓν σ. κ. ἓν πνεῦμα, [[r:EPH.4.4|Eph 4:4.]] (AS)

G4978.strongs: a split or gap ("schism"), literally or figuratively
senses: (σχίζω), a rent (Arist., al.): [[r:MAT.9.16|Mat 9:16]], [[r:MRK.2.21|Mrk 2:21]]. Metaphorical, a dissension, division: [[r:JHN.7.43|Jhn 7:43 9:16 10:19]], [[r:1CO.1.10|1Co 1:10 11:18 12:25]].† SYN.: see: αἵρεσις (AS)

G4933.strongs: to keep closely together, i.e. (by implication) to conserve (from ruin); mentally, to remember (and obey)
senses: συν-τηρέω, -ῶ "perfective" of τηρέω (see M, Pr., 113, 116), to preserve, keep safe, keep close: with accusative of person(s), [[r:MRK.6.20|Mrk 6:20]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.9.17|Mat 9:17]]; ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, [[r:LUK.2.19|Luk 2:19]] (Arist. and later writers; cf. MM, xxiv).† (AS)

G4908.strongs: mentally put (or putting) together, i.e. sagacious
senses: (συνίημι), intelligent, sagacious, understanding: [[r:MAT.11.25|Mat 11:25]], [[r:LUK.10.21|Luk 10:21]], [[r:ACT.13.7|Act 13:7]], [[r:1CO.1.19|1Co 1:19]]" (LXX).† (AS)

G4937.strongs: to crush completely, i.e. to shatter (literally or figuratively)
G4937.kjv: break (in pieces), broken to shivers (+ -hearted), bruise
senses: συν-τρίβω to shatter, break in pieces: [[r:MAT.12.20|Mat 12:20]] (LXX), [[r:MRK.5.4|Mrk 5:4 14:3]], [[r:JHN.19.36|Jhn 19:36]]" (LXX), [[r:REV.2.27|Rev 2:27]]; of persons and parts of the body, to break, crush, bruise: [[r:LUK.9.39|Luk 9:39]]; figuratively, [[r:ROM.16.20|Rom 16:20.]]† (AS)

G4980.strongs: to take a holiday, i.e. be at leisure for (by implication, devote oneself wholly to); figuratively, to be vacant (of a house)
senses: (σχολή), to be at leisure, hence, to have time or opportunity for, to devote oneself to, be occupied in: [[r:1CO.7.5|1Co 7:5]]; of things, to be unoccupied, empty (Plut., Eur., al.): οἶκος, [[r:MAT.12.44|Mat 12:44]], [[r:LUK.11.25|Luk 11:25]] (T, R, om.).† (AS)

G4920.strongs: to put together, i.e. (mentally) to comprehend; by implication, to act piously
senses: συν-ίημι and συνίω (see Bl., § 23, 7),
to bring or set together.

Metaphorical, to perceive, understand: [[r:MAT.13.13|Mat 13:13-15]] (LXX), [[r:MAT.13.19|Mat 13:19 15:10]], [[r:MRK.4.9|Mrk 4:9]] (WH, mg.), [[r:MRK.4.12|Mrk 4:12 7:14 8:17, 21]] [[r:LUK.8.10|Luk 8:10]], [[r:ACT.7.25|Act 7:25 28:26-27]], [[r:ROM.15.21|Rom 15:21]]" (LXX), [[r:2CO.10.12|2Co 10:12]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.13.23|Mat 13:23, 51]], [[r:LUK.2.50|Luk 2:50 18:34 24:45]]; before ὅτι, [[r:MAT.16.12|Mat 16:12 17:13]]; before quæst. indir., [[r:EPH.5.17|Eph 5:17]]; ἐπὶ τ. ἄρτοις, [[r:MRK.6.52|Mrk 6:52]]; as subst., συνίων (ὁ σ., WH, mg.), a man of understanding, i.e. in moral and religious sense, [[r:ROM.3.11|Rom 3:11]] (LXX).† (AS)

G4930.strongs: entire completion, i.e. consummation (of a dispensation)
senses: (συντελέω),
in cl., a joint payment or contribution for public service; hence, generally, joint action (Plat.).
In late writers (Polyb., al.), consummation, completion: σ. τ. αἰῶνος, -ων (cf. Dan LXX TH [[r:DAN.12.13|Dan 12:13]], al.), [[r:MAT.13.39|Mat 13:39-40, 49 24:3 28:20]], [[r:HEB.9.26|Heb 9:26]].† (AS)

G4962.strongs: to twist together, i.e. collect (a bundle, a crowd)
senses: συ-στέφω
to twist together: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ACT.28.3|Act 28:3.]]
Pass., of persons, to gather themselves together: [[r:MAT.17.22|Mat 17:22]] (WH, R, mg.).† (AS)

G4929.strongs: to arrange jointly, i.e. (figuratively) to direct
senses: συν-τάσσω to prescribe, ordain, arrange: with dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.21.6|Mat 21:6 26:19 27:10]]" (LXX).† (AS)
συν-θλάω, -ῶ to crush together, crush: [[r:MAT.21.44|Mat 21:44]] (, R, mg., om.), [[r:LUK.20.18|Luk 20:18.]]† (AS)

G4957.strongs: to impale in company with (literally or figuratively)
senses: συν-σταυρόω (Rec. συσ-), -ῶ, to crucify together with: pass., with dative, [[r:JHN.19.32|Jhn 19:32]]; id. before σύν, [[r:MAT.27.44|Mat 27:44]], [[r:MRK.15.32|Mrk 15:32]]. Metaphorical, of the mystical death of the Christian with Christ: [[r:ROM.6.6|Rom 6:6]], [[r:GAL.2.20|Gal 2:20]] (Eccl.).† (AS)

G4977.strongs: to split or sever (literally or figuratively)
G4977.kjv: break, divide, open, rend, make a rent
senses: σχίζω to cleave, rend: [[r:MAT.27.51|Mat 27:51]], [[r:MRK.1.10|Mrk 1:10 15:38]], [[r:LUK.5.36|Luk 5:36 23:45]], [[r:JHN.19.24|Jhn 19:24 21:11]]; metaphorically, in pass., to be divided into factions, [[r:ACT.14.4|Act 14:4 23:7]].† (AS)

G4972.strongs: to stamp (with a signet or private mark) for security or preservation (literally or figuratively); by implication, to keep secret, to attest
G4972.kjv: (set a, set to) seal up, stop
senses: σφραγίζω to seal,
for security: [[r:MAT.27.66|Mat 27:66]], [[r:REV.20.3|Rev 20:3]]; τ. καρπὸν τοῦτον, figuratively (cf. Deiss., BS, 238 f.; MM, xxiv; DB, iv, 427a), [[r:ROM.15.28|Rom 15:28]];

for concealment, hence, metaphorically, to hide (Da TH [[r:DAN.9.24|Dan 9:24]], [[r:JHN.14.17|Jhn 14:17]]): [[r:REV.10.4|Rev 10:4 22:10]]; (with) for distinction, [[r:REV.7.3|Rev 7:3-8]]; metaphorically, [[r:EPH.4.30|Eph 4:30]]; mid., [[r:2CO.1.22|2Co 1:22]];
for authentication ([[r:EST.8.8|Est 8:8]]): [[r:JHN.3.33|Jhn 3:33 6:27]] (cf. κατα-σφραγίζω).† (AS)

G4993.strongs: to be of sound mind, i.e. sane, (figuratively) moderate
G4993.kjv: be in right mind, be sober (minded), soberly
senses: (σώφρων),
to be of sound mind or in one's right mind: [[r:MRK.5.15|Mrk 5:15]], [[r:LUK.8.35|Luk 8:35]]; opposite to ἐκστῆναι, [[r:2CO.5.13|2Co 5:13]] (Hdt.);

to be temperate, discreet, self-controlled (opposite to μαίνεσθαι, ὑβρίζειν, etc.; sch., Thuc., al.): [[r:TIT.2.6|Tit 2:6]]; opposite to ὑπερφρονεῖν, [[r:ROM.12.3|Rom 12:3]]; σ. καὶ νήφειν, [[r:1PE.4.7|1Pe 4:7.]]† (AS)

G4918.strongs: to compress, i.e. crowd on all sides
senses: συν-θλίβω to press together, press on all sides: [[r:MRK.5.24|Mrk 5:24, 31]].† (AS)

G4936.strongs: to rush together (hastily assemble) or headlong (figuratively)
senses: συν-τρέχω to run together or with: before ἐκεῖ, [[r:MRK.6.33|Mrk 6:33]]; πρόσ, with accusative, [[r:ACT.3.11|Act 3:11]]; metaphorically, [[r:1PE.4.4|1Pe 4:4.]]† (AS)

G4949.root: feminine of a compound of [[w:G4948]] and the same as [[w:G5403]]
G4949.strongs: a Syro-phœnician woman, i.e. a female native of Phœnicia in Syria
senses: Συροφοινίκισσα (Rec. -φοίνισσα), -ης, ἡ a Syropænician woman: [[r:MRK.7.26|Mrk 7:26]], WH, txt., RV (cf. ἡ Φοινίκη Συρία, Diod., 19, 93).† (AS)

G4952.strongs: to rend completely, i.e. (by analogy) to convulse violently
senses: συ-σπαράσσω to convulse completely: with accusative of person(s), [[r:MRK.9.20|Mrk 9:20]], [[r:LUK.9.42|Luk 9:42]] (cf. σπαράσσω).† (AS)

G4907.strongs: a mental putting together, i.e. intelligence or (concretely) the intellect
senses: (συνίημι),
a running or flowing together (Hom.).
the understanding, the mind or intelligence: [[r:MRK.12.33|Mrk 12:33.]]† SYN.: see: σοφία (AS)

G4931.strongs: to complete entirely; generally, to execute (literally or figuratively)
senses: συν-τελέω, -ῶ "perfective" of τελέω (cf. M, Pr., 118),
to complete, finish, bring to an end: [[r:LUK.4.13|Luk 4:13]]; pass., [[r:LUK.4.2|Luk 4:2]], [[r:JHN.2.3|Jhn 2:3]], WH, mg., [[r:ACT.21.27|Act 21:27.]]
to effect, accomplish, bring to fulfilment (cf. MM, xxiv): [[r:MRK.13.4|Mrk 13:4]], [[r:ROM.9.28|Rom 9:28]], [[r:HEB.8.8|Heb 8:8]].† (AS)

G4953.root: neuter of a compound of [[w:G4862]] and the base of [[w:G4591]]
G4953.strongs: a sign in common, i.e. preconcerted signal
senses: σύσ-σημον (T, συν-), -ου, τό (σῆμα), a fixed sign or signal: [[r:MRK.14.44|Mrk 14:44.]] (Strab., Plut., al.; condemned by Atticists, see Rutherford, NPhr., 492 f.) † (AS)

G4955.root: from a compound of [[w:G4862]] and a derivative of [[w:G4714]]
senses: στασιαστής (στασιάζω, to stir up sedition, [[r:JDT.7.15|Jdth.7:15]], [[r:2MA.4.30|2Ma 4:30]] [[r:2MAC.14.6|2Mac 14:6]] *) = Att.. στασιώτης, a rebel, revolutionist, one who stirs up sedition: [[r:MRK.15.7|Mrk 15:7]] (FlJ, al.).† συ-στασιαστής, -οῦ, ὁ, a fellow-rioter: [[r:MRK.15.7|Mrk 15:7]], Rec.† (AS)

G4903.strongs: to be a fellow-worker, i.e. co-operate
senses: prop., to work together (with): absol., [[r:MRK.16.20|Mrk 16:20]], [[r:1CO.16.16|1Co 16:16]], [[r:2CO.6.1|2Co 6:1]]; with dative, [[r:JAS.2.22|Jas 2:22]]; dative commod., [[r:ROM.8.28|Rom 8:28]], T, R, txt. (but see infr.).
In Hellenistic writers (M, Pr., 65), trans., to cause to work together (cf. ICC, in l): with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ROM.8.28|Rom 8:28]] R, mg. (but see supr.).† (AS)

G4990.strongs: a deliverer, i.e. God or Christ
senses: (σώζω), saviour, deliverer, preserver, a frequently epithet of kings in the Ptolemaic and Rom. periods (Deiss., BS, 83; LAE, 368 f.; MM, xxiv), in NT,

of Christ: [[r:LUK.2.11|Luk 2:11]], [[r:ACT.5.31|Act 5:31 13:23]], [[r:PHP.3.20|Php 3:20]]; τ. κόσμου, [[r:JHN.4.42|Jhn 4:42]], [[r:1JN.4.14|1Jn 4:14]] (for the general use of the word, see Westc., in l); ἡμῶν, [[r:2TI.1.10|2Ti 1:10]], [[r:TIT.1.4|Tit 1:4 3:6]]; θεὸς (κύριος) καὶ σ. (see Deiss., LAE, 348.4; M, Pr., 84), [[r:TIT.2.13|Tit 2:13]], [[r:2PE.1.1|2Pe 1:1 1:11 2:20 3:2 3:18]]; σ. τοῦ σώματος (i.e. of the Church; see: σῶμα, 5), [[r:EPH.5.23|Eph 5:23.]]† (AS)

G4991.root: feminine of a derivative of [[w:G4990]] as (properly, abstract) noun
senses: (σωτήρ), deliverance, preservation, salvation, safety (Lat. salus): [[r:ACT.7.25|Act 7:25 27:34]], [[r:HEB.11.7|Heb 11:7]]; ἐξ ἐχθρῶν, [[r:LUK.1.71|Luk 1:71.]] In NT esp. of Messianic and spiritual salvation (see: σώζω): [[r:LUK.19.9|Luk 19:9]], [[r:JHN.4.22|Jhn 4:22]], [[r:ACT.4.12|Act 4:12 13:47]], [[r:ROM.11.11|Rom 11:11]], [[r:2TH.2.13|2Th 2:13]], [[r:2TI.3.15|2Ti 3:15]], [[r:HEB.2.3|Heb 2:3 6:9]], [[r:2PE.3.15|2Pe 3:15]], Ju 3; opposite to ἀπηώλεια, [[r:PHP.1.28|Php 1:28]]; αἰώνιος-., [[r:HEB.5.9|Heb 5:9]]; ὁ λόγος (τὸ εὐαγγέλιον) τῆς σ., [[r:ACT.13.26|Act 13:26]], [[r:EPH.1.13|Eph 1:13]]; ὁδὸς σωτηρίας, [[r:ACT.16.17|Act 16:17]]; κέρας σωτηρίας, [[r:LUK.1.69|Luk 1:69]]; ἡμέρα σωτηρίας, [[r:2CO.6.2|2Co 6:2]] (LXX); κατεργάζεσθαι τὴν ἑαυτοῦ σ., [[r:PHP.2.12|Php 2:12]]; κληρονομεῖν σ., [[r:HEB.1.14|Heb 1:14]]; ὁ ἀρχηγὸς τῆς σ., [[r:HEB.2.10|Heb 2:10]]; εἰς σ., [[r:ROM.1.16|Rom 1:16 10:1, 10]], [[r:1PE.2.2|1Pe 2:2]]; σ. as a present possession (see: σώζω), [[r:LUK.1.77|Luk 1:77]], [[r:2CO.1.6|2Co 1:6 7:10]], [[r:PHP.1.19|Php 1:19]], [[r:2TI.2.10|2Ti 2:10]]; as more fully realized in the future: [[r:ROM.13.11|Rom 13:11]], [[r:1TH.5.8|1Th 5:8-9]], [[r:HEB.9.28|Heb 9:28]], [[r:1PE.1.5|1Pe 1:5 1:9-10]], [[r:REV.7.10|Rev 7:10 12:10 19:1]].† (AS)

G4992.root: neuter of the same as [[w:G4991]] as (properly, concretely) noun
senses: σωτήριος, -ον (σωτήρ), saving, bringing salvation, in NT always in spiritual sense (see: σώζω, σωτηρία): ἡ χάρις ἡ σ., [[r:TIT.2.1|Tit 2:1.]] Neut., -τὸ σ., as subst. (cl.), salvation: [[r:LUK.2.30|Luk 2:30]]; τ. σ. τ. θεοῦ, [[r:LUK.3.6|Luk 3:6]], [[r:ACT.28.28|Act 28:28]]; περικεφαλαίαν τοῦ σ., [[r:EPH.6.17|Eph 6:17.]]† (AS)

G4923.strongs: companionship on a journey, i.e. (by implication), a caravan
senses: a journey in company (Plut., al.).
By meton., κ company of travellers, a caravan: [[r:LUK.2.44|Luk 2:44.]]† (AS)
(σῶμα),
of or for the body, bodily: γυμνασία, [[r:1TI.4.8|1Ti 4:8]];
(opposite to ἀσώματος) bodily, corporeal: εἶδος, [[r:LUK.3.22|Luk 3:22.]]† (AS)

G4948.strongs: a Syran (i.e. probably Tyrian), a native of Syria
